title: Norsine's bioenergetics work with Duncan Luri

tellings.quote: John was working with him on [sighs and gasps]

plain: Jim Weiner, a man who says he was part of an abduction experience, mentions that John Norsine worked with a man named Duncan Luri in Jamestown, Rhode Island. The work was in bioenergetics, a loose term for the study of energy in living bodies, though Weiner's description of exactly what they did trails off. He brings it up as part of the background of the people around his story.
